subject: Go-live surge credits + founders discount request — Aurelia Therapeutics
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Priya Rao <priya.rao@aureliatx.com>
Date: Mon, 28 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: founders discount + go-live credits

Hi Priya —

Great speaking last week. Per our conversation, I put together a short proposal to accelerate your go-live:

- 50k free inference credits to cover the first two production weeks (surge buffer)
- Founder’s discount: 20% off list for first 6 months if you convert to a 12‑month commit within 45 days of go‑live
- Optional extended trial: +4 weeks if you need more validation time (no charge)

I’ve attached a short term sheet and our Q2 usage summary so you can see typical burst costs. If that looks good I can start an internal approval thread for the credits + discount.

If you agree, next steps: sign the term sheet (we can DocuSign) and I’ll route the credits to your account.

Thanks —
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0162

Attachments: proposed_term_sheet_v3.pdf (pdf)
From: Dr. Priya Rao <priya.rao@aureliatx.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 May 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: founders discount + go-live credits

Marcus —

Thanks for the quick turn. The proposal is promising but two asks from our side before we can sign off:

1) Can you increase the free credits to 150k for the first 30 days? We expect a large burst during user onboarding and need a buffer.
2) We’d like the trial extension to be 6 weeks (not 4) so our clinical validation team can run the additional dataset.

Commit: we’re comfortable with a 12‑month conversion if you can meet the above and keep the 20% for at least the first 90 days after conversion.

Also: our security/ops team will want a short SLA note about incident response time during the go‑live. I can loop them in.

—Priya
Priya Rao, PhD
Head of Product & Clinical Ops | Aurelia Therapeutics
priya.rao@aureliatx.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Proposal: founders discount + go-live credits — escalation for exec approval

Team — forwarding Aurelia’s reply (below). They’ve asked for: 150k free credits (30d), extend trial to 6 weeks, and a 20% founders discount to be preserved for 90 days post‑conversion. They’ve indicated a likely 12‑month commit if we can accommodate.

Why this matters: Aurelia is a high‑visibility biotech account; if we secure them as a committed customer this quarter they become a reference for several other clinical customers in our pipeline. They plan a mid‑July go‑live window and need the credits routed in advance.

Request: please approve the following exception so I can close this week:
- Up to 150,000 free inference credits to be applied on go‑live (can be staged: 100k upfront, 50k on week 3 if utilization warrants)
- Founder’s discount: 20% off list for 6 months; preserve discount for 90 days post‑conversion as they requested
- Trial extension: 6 weeks, no charge

Constraints we need: credits should be time‑boxed (30 days), not refundable, and applied only to inference consumption (no embedding-only reclassification). Need legal to sign off on the discount language and CS to handle credits application schedule.

Attachments: Aurelia_Q22028_usage_report.pdf; proposed_term_sheet_v3.pdf

Please reply with APPROVE or DECLINE and any modification. I can also hop on a quick call.

Thanks —
Marcus
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 3 Jun 2028 09:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Proposal: founders discount + go-live credits — escalation for exec approval

Marcus / Marissa —

I’ve reviewed Aurelia’s ask and the usage report. I’m comfortable granting a limited make‑good here given strategic value. Approve subject to the following guardrails:

- Approve 120k free credits upfront, with an additional 30k contingent on verified usage by CS at day 14 (total 150k possible)
- Approve 20% founders discount for 6 months; we’ll include a sunset clause that preserves it for 90 days post‑conversion as requested
- Approve 6‑week trial extension

Legal note: Kimberly, please add a clause limiting credits to inference token consumption and defining the verification step for additional credits. Also include the 30‑day timebox for the credit program.

Monica — please prepare a CS playbook: credit application schedule and a short verification checklist for day‑14 usage review.

If legal okays language, Marcus you can send the term sheet and DocuSign to Aurelia.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
VP, Commercial | Redwood Inference

Subject: Approved: go‑live credits and founders discount (next steps & DocuSign)

Priya —

Good news: leadership has approved a conditional package to support your July go‑live. Summary:

- Credits: 120,000 free inference credits will be applied at go‑live (immediate). An additional 30,000 credits are held in reserve and will be released after a CS verification at day 14 if utilization warrants (total possible 150k). Credits are time‑boxed to 30 days from go‑live and apply only to inference token consumption.
- Discount: 20% founders discount on list pricing for the first 6 months after conversion. Discount will be preserved for 90 days post‑conversion per your request.
- Trial: 6‑week extension granted.

Next steps:
1) Kimberly has drafted the credit/discount clause; DocuSign envelope is ready: https://docusign.com/recipient/abc123
2) Monica will apply the initial 120k credits once we receive the signed term sheet and confirm your go‑live date.
3) CS will run a day‑14 usage verification to decide on the additional 30k release.

I’ve attached the revised term sheet. Please review and sign the DocuSign by Friday to ensure credits are in place ahead of your go‑live. Happy to jump on a call if you want to walk through the verification checklist.

Thanks and excited to get you across the finish line.
